name: Long Live the empress Season 2: Yongui Juin
original_name: Long Live the empress Season 2 : 용의 주인
source:
This is your second story in Long Live the Empress. Peace is finally here in Heath. You, the empress, are living in bliss with your loved one, until foreigners bring you disaster... The dragon wakes from its long slumber, and a crisis engulfs the continent. Can you overcome this trial and save both your loved one and your empire?

[From in-app]
